A simultaneous formula induction proves full modal equivalence, and depth-one principal-upset valuations prove injectivity. Ballot counting of the two independent families yields Cat_n^2. Standalone direct exhaustive checks of all 1,9,3375 raw frames on n=1,2,3 and independent canonical pairs through n=5 reproduce the count.

value.rationale: Provides a complete, exact all-n observational classification of two-modal constructive neighbourhood structures under a natural serial/reflexive center condition. The one-interval-per-world normal form gives semantic data compression and reduction to a sharp finite search space, not a routine numerical sample. Distinguishability at modal depth one and a Catalan-square closed count establish precise full expressive power and canonical representatives. Relevant to modal model checking and controlled comparisons of neighbourhood versus relational semantics.
